_note: Event Mode countdown hud, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. Both lines use countdown.color; edge_color is their outline; text_nudge moves the text inside its glyph box.

pill._note: the cream pill at the top-left, its top-left at x, y; each line after the first adds line_height; its corners are half its one-line height round

countdown._note: the seconds turn red (and tick each second) from red_from_s down; the text is at most the pill's width less text_margin wide; the plays line sits line_gap below the line height
